name: nbpt-living
description: Clipper Town — an all-ages adventure on the exact maps of real towns (Newburyport, Salem, …)

scripts.map: npm run fetch-osm && npm run build-world && npm run fetch-terrain
scripts.build:all: node tools/check_town_assets.mjs && node tools/check_town_spawn.mjs && npm run share && TOWN=salem vite build && rm -rf dist/salem && mv dist-salem dist/salem && TOWN=beverly vite build && rm -rf dist/beverly && mv dist-beverly dist/beverly
